title: Residual Guidance for Real-Time Interactive Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32820v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-time interactive video generation allows users to change the prompt during generation to steer the evolving video. However, existing streaming models, which generate videos chunk by chunk, often keep following the previous prompt after a switch. We trace this failure to context inertia, where the previous chunk acts as a strong prior that suppresses the new prompt. Furthermore, we find that this inertia persists even when the cache retains only the previous chunk, yet discarding the context breaks visual continuity, which limits approaches that edit the cache. Rather than editing the cache, we propose Residual Guidance (RG), a simple, training-free method that counteracts context inertia with a correction measured outside the cache. Specifically, RG denoises the re-noised previous chunk once under the new prompt without the cache and adds the resulting residual to the early denoising steps of the next chunk, where its content is l

translated_title: 实时交互式视频生成的残差引导
translated_abstract: 实时交互式视频生成允许用户在生成过程中修改提示词，以引导正在生成的视频内容。然而，现有的逐块生成视频的流式模型在提示词切换后往往仍继续遵循之前的提示词。我们将这种失败归因于“上下文惯性”，即前一个视频块作为强先验抑制了新提示词的作用。此外，我们发现即使缓存中仅保留前一个块，这种惯性依然存在；而丢弃上下文又会破坏视觉连续性，这使得编辑缓存类的方法受到限制。我们不再编辑缓存，而是提出残差引导（Residual Guidance, RG）——一种简单且无需训练的方法，通过在缓存之外测量的校正来抵消上下文惯性。具体而言，RG 在无缓存的条件下，使用新提示词对重新加噪的前一个块进行一次去噪，并将得到的残差添加到下一个块的早期去噪步骤中，其内容在该阶段……
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的残差引导方法（RG），通过在缓存之外计算的校正残差来抵消流式视频生成中的上下文惯性，使模型在提示词切换时能迅速响应新指令并保持视觉连续性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Residual Guidance (RG), a simple training-free method that counteracts context inertia in streaming video generation by applying a correction residual computed outside the cache, enabling the model to promptly follow prompt switches while preserving visual continuity.
